offer.text: Something keeps cratering the road and the garden walls. Hunt down four creepers before they take a house with them.

accept.text: Carefully, now — let them get close and you'll share the blast.

decline.text: Then mind your step near the walls.

in_progress.text: Any of those hissing wretches dealt with?

ready.text: Four fewer holes in my road. Good.

complete.text: The masons thank you, and so do I. Fine work.
